silver_mask.name: Silver Mask
silver_mask.lore: Expressionless. The Mask Offering in the Eclipse Court wants it.

contraband.name: Smuggler's Token
contraband.lore: Stamped with a hand that is not a customs hand. The Smuggler's Exchange takes it.

eclipse_key.name: Eclipse Key
eclipse_key.lore: Opens the black door to the Throne of the Eclipse.

onDone.text: The lanterns steady and the dark thins. The causeway will be easier to read now.
Somewhere a wall slides. The way out of the alleys opens, and so does a wall in the north.

waves.say: The searchlight swings down. The watch has noticed you.

onDone.text: The lamp goes out. A Silver Mask lies on the plate, staring at nothing.

onOpen.text: The token is stamped and shoved under the counter. Somewhere a wall opens in the north-west.

mechanics.hint: A back-alley counter with a slot for a token.
mechanics.verb: slips the Smuggler's Token across the counter.

onOpen.text: The mask slots onto the blank stone. A false wall in the south sags open.

mechanics.hint: A blank stone face with nothing to look at.
mechanics.verb: hangs the Silver Mask on the blank face and a wall sags open.

onOpen.text: The black door to the Throne of the Eclipse opens.

mechanics.hint: A black door with a keyhole that swallows light.
mechanics.verb: turns the Eclipse Key and the black door opens.

encounters.say: The alleys are narrow and the lamps are few. Something follows, one turning behind.
An eclipse hangs over the court. A counter stands in a back alley; a blank face watches the south.

bosses.name: The Eclipse
bosses.intro: The Eclipse takes the throne. Black out the three gold crowns on the pillars to unseat it.
bosses.deathText: The Eclipse stands up out of the throne and is not there.

shield.breakText: The crowns go black! The Eclipse is exposed!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Eclipse calls its servants.

effects.text: The light goes out of the room.

completion.intro: The Eclipse Throne. Find the hidden lever in the alleys and cross the blackwater.
completion.message: The shadows draw back. The throne room closes shortly.
